title: Almost 600 housing units planned for suburban transpo center north of Boston
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Massport has approved a developer for a mixed-use project at the Anderson Regional Transportation Center in Woburn.
A proposed development at Woburn’s Anderson Regional Transportation Center could bring nearly 600 rental housing units and retail space to the transit hub, according to Massport.

The agency’s board announced that it voted Thursday to approve Cabot, Cabot & Forbes (CC&F) as the developer for the proposed mixed-use project, which would transform about six acres of the 26-acre facility into a residential and retail development.
